title: Site rules for a cold-storage warehouse
heading: OnlyEnforceIf Switches a Linear Row On a Conjunction of Literals
cases: a night shift with its minimum crew is allowed, and one short-staffed is refused
a closed freezer with no frozen orders is allowed, and one with orders is refused
two open docks with enough forklifts are allowed, and with too few are refused
either dock open alone needs no extra forklifts
a day with no night shift has no night staff
an open freezer may take frozen orders
